records.objectives_text: Find the ruby, sapphire, and topaz that are scattered throughout Uldaman. Once acquired, contact Talvash del Kissel remotely by using the Phial of Scrying he previously gave you. From the journal, you know...

objectives.text: The ruby has been stashed in a barricaded Shadowforge area.
The topaz has been hidden in an urn in one of the Trogg areas, near some Alliance dwarves.
The sapphire has been claimed by Grimlok, the trogg leader.

These actions must be performed in the correct order, as Fizzule will attack and terminate

records.objectives_text: Use the Empty Leaden Collection Phial on Irradiated Invaders or Irradiated Pillagers to collect radioactive fallout. Once it is full, take it back to Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos.

records.name: The Day After
records.objectives_text: Speak with Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos.

records.name: Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators
records.objectives_text: Bring twenty-four Robo-Mechanical Guts to Shoni in Stormwind.

records.name: The Grand Betrayal
records.objectives_text: Venture to Gnomeregan and kill Mekgineer Thermaplugg. Return to High Tinker Mekkatorque when the task is complete.

records.name: Data Rescue
records.objectives_text: Bring a Prismatic Punch Card to Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge.

records.name: Castpipe's Task
records.objectives_text: Speak with Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge.

records.name: Grim Message
records.objectives_text: Gather Witherbark Skulls and place on Nimboya's Pike. Place Nimboya's Laden Pike at one of the Witherbark Villages in the Hinterlands, then return to Nimboya in Stranglethorn.

records.name: Venom Bottles
records.objectives_text: Bring a Venom Bottle to an apothecary in Tarren Mill.

records.name: Undamaged Venom Sac
records.objectives_text: Bring an Undamaged Venom Sac to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

records.name: Consult Master Gadrin
records.objectives_text: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

records.name: The Spider God
records.objectives_text: Read from the Tablet of Theka to learn the name of the Witherbark spider god, then return to Master Gadrin.

records.name: Summoning Shadra
records.objectives_text: Defeat Shadra at the altar of Shadra'Alor, then bring her venom to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

records.name: Venom to the Undercity
records.objectives_text: Bring Faranell's Parcel to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

records.name: In Search of Knowledge
records.objectives_text: Talk to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village.

records.name: Feralas: A History
records.objectives_text: Ask Daryn Lightwind if you may borrow her book.

records.name: The Borrower
records.objectives_text: Take the letter to Curgle Cranklehop in Tanaris.

records.name: The Morrow Stone
records.objectives_text: Return the Sparkling Stone and the Stave of Equinex to Troyas Moonbreeze in Feathermoon Stronghold.

records.name: Return to Troyas
records.objectives_text: Deliver the book to Troyas Moonbreeze in Feathermoon Stronghold.

records.name: The Super Snapper FX
records.objectives_text: Use the Super Snapper FX to take a snapshot of Gammerita, then return to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village.

records.name: Grime-Encrusted Ring
records.objectives_text: Figure out a way to remove the grime from the Grime-Encrusted Ring.

records.name: Seeing What Happens
records.objectives_text: Bring the miniature platinum discs to the gates of Uldum in Tanaris and look for clues as to the connection between the two.

records.name: Return of the Ring
records.objectives_text: You may either keep the ring, or you may find the person responsible for the imprint and engravings on the inside of the band.

records.name: Gnome Improvement
records.objectives_text: Bring the Brilliant Gold Ring, a Silver Bar, a Moss Agate, and 30 silver coins to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.

records.name: Return of the Ring
records.objectives_text: You may either keep the ring, or you may find the person responsible for the imprint and engravings on the inside of the band.

records.name: Nogg's Ring Redo
records.objectives_text: Bring the Brilliant Gold Ring, a Silver Bar, a Moss Agate, and 30 silver coins to Nogg in Orgrimmar.

records.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
records.objectives_text: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.

records.name: The Stone Watcher
records.objectives_text: Learn the purpose of the Stone Watcher of Norgannon, and then interact with the Uldum Pedestal in the Tanaris desert.

objectives.text: Learn the purpose of the Stone Watcher of Norgannon

records.name: The Only Cure is More Green Glow
records.objectives_text: Travel to Gnomeregan and bring back High Potency Radioactive Fallout. Be warned, the fallout is unstable and will collapse rather quickly. Ozzie will also require your Heavy Leaden Collection Phial when the task is complete.

wiki.page: The Only Cure is More Green Glow

records.name: Portents of Uldum
records.objectives_text: Speak with Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers within Ironforge.

records.name: A Future Task
records.objectives_text: Speak with High Explorer Magellas in Ironforge.

records.name: Portents of Uldum
records.objectives_text: Speak with Nara Wildmane on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.

records.name: Seeing What Happens
records.objectives_text: Bring the miniature platinum discs to the gates of Uldum in Tanaris and look for clues as to the connection between the two.

records.name: Return to Thunder Bluff
records.objectives_text: Speak with Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.

records.name: A Future Task
records.objectives_text: Speak with Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.

records.name: Freedom for All Creatures
records.objectives_text: Using the Bamboo Cage Key, free the Sprite Darters from the pen in the Grimtotem camp. At least 6 Sprite Darters and Kindal Moonweaver must survive. You have 6 minutes before Kindal decides it is time to retreat and you fail the quest.

objectives.text: Save at least 6 Sprite Darters from capture

records.name: Doling Justice
records.objectives_text: Kill 12 Grimtotem Naturalists, 10 Grimtotem Raiders, and 6 Grimtotem Shamans before returning to Jer'kai Moonweaver in Feralas.

records.name: Doling Justice
records.objectives_text: Take Jer'kai's Signet Ring to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus.

records.name: A Grim Discovery
records.objectives_text: Bring 20 Grimtotem Horns to Krueg Skullsplitter in Camp Mojache.

records.name: The Ogres of Feralas
records.objectives_text: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Ogres, 10 Gordunni Ogre-Magi, and 5 Gordunni Brutes.

records.name: A Grim Discovery
records.objectives_text: Bring the Crate of Grimtotem Horns to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.

records.name: Return to Ironforge
records.objectives_text: Speak with Historian Karnik in Ironforge.

records.name: The Gordunni Scroll
records.objectives_text: Bring the Gordunni Scroll to Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache.

records.name: Dark Ceremony
records.objectives_text: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to find a Gordunni Orb.

records.name: The Ogres of Feralas
records.objectives_text: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Shaman, 10 Gordunni Warlocks, and 5 Gordunni Maulers.

records.name: A Threat in Feralas
records.objectives_text: Belgrom Rockmaul wants you to speak with Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache.

records.name: The High Wilderness
records.objectives_text: Angelas Moonbreeze wants you to kill 8 Gordunni Warlocks, 8 Gordunni Shaman, and 8 Gordunni Brutes.

records.name: Call of Water
records.objectives_text: Find Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

records.name: Gordunni Cobalt
records.objectives_text: Orwin Gizzmick in Camp Mojache wants 12 samples of Gordunni Cobalt.

records.name: Witherbark Cages
records.objectives_text: Check the cages at the two Witherbark villages, then return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.

records.name: The Altar of Zul
records.objectives_text: Check the top of the Altar of Zul, then return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.

records.name: Thadius Grimshade
records.objectives_text: Bring Sharpbeak's Feather to Thadius Grimshade in the Blasted Lands.

records.name: Nekrum's Medallion
records.objectives_text: Bring Nekrum's Medallion to Thadius Grimshade in the Blasted Lands.

records.name: The Divination
records.objectives_text: Wait until Grimshade performs the ritual of divination.

records.name: Return to the Hinterlands
records.objectives_text: Speak with Gryphon Master Talonaxe.

records.name: Saving Sharpbeak
records.objectives_text: Fight to the top of Jintha'Alor, kill Vile Priestess Hexx for the key to Sharpbeak's cage, and save Sharpbeak.

records.name: Lines of Communication
records.objectives_text: Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity wants you to travel to the Hinterlands and burn the Highvale Records, Highvale Report, and Highvale Notes.

records.name: Seeking Strahad
records.objectives_text: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.

records.name: Tome of Divinity
records.objectives_text: Speak to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge.

records.name: Tome of Divinity
records.objectives_text: Speak to Duthorian Rall in Stormwind.

records.name: Tome of Divinity
records.objectives_text: Speak to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge
